ActionDescriptions.ToSummarizeSessionHistory:
to build a rolling summary from session history pages
Slow recap tool. Do not use for routine session inspection, child-session progress, or latest-result retrieval; prefer SessionManagement turn-summary tools such as ToGetMostRecentSessionTurn first. sessionKey - target session key. startUtc/endUtc - required ISO UTC bounds. carryContext - optional prior summary context used for chaining.
